b58ebc81: Sauron forges the One Ring in the fires of Mount Doom (Orodruin) to control the other Rings of Power.
764610ff: In which mountain can the Ring be destroyed?
The Ring can only be destroyed in Mount Doom (Orodruin), where it was forged, in the Cracks of Doom.
f8ad85ed: What is the name of the hobbit who owns the Ring at the start of The Lord of the Rings?
Bilbo Baggins finds the Ring in Gollum's caves, keeps it for sixty years, then leaves it to Frodo.

Frodo Baggins is the hobbit charged with carrying and destroying the One Ring. He lives in the Shire.

“Ash nazg durbatulûk” opens the Ring's inscription in the Black Speech: “One Ring to rule them all”.
ad5d157d: How many hobbits set out from the Shire at the start of The Fellowship of the Ring?
Four hobbits set out: Frodo, Sam, Merry and Pippin (Peregrin Took).
42d8a12a: Men made undying and corrupted by the Rings
The Nazgûl, or Ringwraiths, are nine former kings of Men, corrupted by their Rings and made into Sauron's servants.
8e3307e5: What is the name of the leader of the Nazgûl?
The Witch-king of Angmar is the leader of the Nazgûl. He is killed by Éowyn, with Merry's help.
8df14bf9: What is the name of the Elf-lord of Imladris (Rivendell)?
Elrond Half-elven is the lord of Rivendell (Imladris). He presides over the Council that decides the Ring's fate.
2ad6fef7: What is the name of the Elven forest ruled by Galadriel and Celeborn?
Lothlórien is the Elven forest kept by Galadriel and Celeborn. It is home to the mallorn trees with their golden leaves.
7375e28f: What is the name of the Elf queen of Lothlórien?
Galadriel is the Lady of Lothlórien. She bears Nenya, the Ring of Water, and gives gifts to the Fellowship.
2f19fd95: Andúril is the reforged Narsil, Elendil's broken sword. Aragorn receives it as proof of his royal heritage.
9fd7a6b7: What nickname do the people of Bree give Aragorn?
In Bree, Aragorn is known as Strider, a Ranger of the North. Estel is his childhood name, Elessar his name as king.
e62fe6c5: Who says the famous line “You shall not pass!”?
Gandalf says “You shall not pass!” on the Bridge of Khazad-dûm, facing the Balrog.
72ba152d: What is the Balrog Gandalf fights in Moria called?
The Balrog of Moria is called Durin's Bane: it killed the Dwarf king Durin VI.
1e701ecf: Which river do Frodo and Sam cross when they leave the Fellowship?
Frodo and Sam cross the Anduin, the Great River, when the Fellowship breaks at Amon Hen.
89bf4127: What is the name of Sauron's fortress in Mordor?
Barad-dûr, the Dark Tower, is Sauron's main fortress in Mordor. The Eye of Sauron watches from its summit.
b5a1caac: What is the capital of Gondor?
Minas Tirith is the capital of Gondor, a city of seven levels built against Mount Mindolluin.
d464ba3d: What is the name of the capital of Rohan?
Edoras is the capital of Rohan, where King Théoden's golden hall, Meduseld, stands.
2530b123: What is the name of Rohan's defensive stronghold in The Two Towers?
Helm's Deep, with its fortress the Hornburg, is Rohan's refuge and the site of the great battle of The Two Towers.
7b1943a1: What is the name of the King of Rohan who is under Saruman's sway?
King Théoden is held in thrall by his counselor Wormtongue, Saruman's agent, until Gandalf frees him.
ee89816b: Gríma Wormtongue is Théoden's treacherous counselor, an agent of Saruman who poisoned the king's mind.
3f18886d: How many Rings of Power were forged in total?
20 Rings in total: 3 for the Elven-kings, 7 for the Dwarf-lords, 9 for Mortal Men, plus the One Ring.
6a3f3ff4: Which sword cut the Ring from Sauron's finger?
Narsil, Elendil's sword, breaks during the battle. Isildur uses its shard to cut the Ring from Sauron's hand. Reforged, it becomes Andúril.
e5010e54: What is the name of Frodo's blade?
Sting is an Elvish blade named by Bilbo. It glows blue when Orcs or goblins are near.
06eee569: Who is Glorfindel and what is his role?
An Elf of Rivendell who helps bring Frodo to safety
Glorfindel is a mighty Elf of Rivendell who helps Frodo reach the Ford of Bruinen.
328910b8: Gimli is a Dwarf of the Lonely Mountain, son of Glóin. He represents the Dwarves at the Council of Elrond.
ffdf1980: Which bow does Legolas carry for much of the films?
Legolas uses the bow of the Galadhrim, an Elven longbow given to him during his stay in Lothlórien.
8295bdc9: What are the spy birds of Saruman called?
The crebain, a kind of crow, spy for Saruman. To avoid them, the Fellowship tries to cross Caradhras.
6a430f11: What is special about the Elven cloaks given to the Fellowship in Lothlórien?
They make the wearer hard to see, blending into the landscape
The cloaks of Lothlórien let their wearers blend into their surroundings, making them hard to spot.
725b06f1: Which palantír (seeing-stone) is used in the story?
Saruman holds the palantír of Orthanc, through which Sauron manipulates him. Pippin looks into it by mistake.
20190f5d: What is the name of the giant spider in the Ephel Dúath mountains?
Shelob lives in the tunnels of Cirith Ungol. She stings Frodo, but Sam wounds her with Sting.
034ebe37: How does Éowyn manage to kill the Witch-king (given the prophecy)?
She is a woman and Merry is a hobbit
She uses the Light of Eärendil
The prophecy says that no living man can kill the Witch-king. Éowyn is a woman and Merry a hobbit, getting around the prophecy.
df48ba59: What is the name of Frodo's father?
Drogo Baggins is Frodo's father. He drowned in the Brandywine with his wife Primula.
cb0eb453: What is the name of Bilbo and Frodo's home in the Shire?
Bag End is the hobbit-hole of Bilbo and later Frodo, in Hobbiton.
ffcbcf4b: What kind of being is Sauron in Tolkien's cosmology?
Sauron is a Maia (a lesser divine spirit), servant of the Vala Morgoth. Gandalf is also a Maia.
0f0451ea: What is the name of the ancient power Sauron once served?
Morgoth (Melkor) is the first Dark Lord, the source of evil in the world. Sauron was his lieutenant.
ac4a9f87: What does the White Tree of Gondor symbolize?
The White Tree of Gondor symbolizes the royal line descended from Númenor. Its renewal heralds the return of the rightful King.
dcda5025: What is the title of the first volume of The Lord of the Rings?
The Fellowship of the Ring is the first volume of J.R.R. Tolkien's work.
b2fcc658: Who is the author of The Lord of the Rings?
J.R.R. Tolkien (John Ronald Reuel Tolkien) wrote The Lord of the Rings, published in 1954 and 1955.
b5bfa209: What is the title of the prequel to The Lord of the Rings?
The Hobbit (1937) is the novel that precedes The Lord of the Rings. It follows Bilbo Baggins's adventure with Gandalf.
4e5ce299: For how many years does Bilbo keep the Ring?
Bilbo keeps the Ring for 60 years (from 2941 to 3001 of the Third Age) and celebrates his 111th birthday before giving it up.
60686373: What is Saruman's black fortress at the heart of Isengard?
Orthanc is the black stone tower at the center of Isengard, Saruman's home. It cannot be destroyed.
c577bb89: Where do the Dwarves come from in Tolkien's cosmology?
They are born from the earth
They were made by Aulë and adopted by Eru
They are a special kind of Men
Aulë made the Dwarves but could not give them true life. Eru (Ilúvatar) granted them souls of their own and a separate destiny.
e853e20d: What is the name of Sam's father?
Hamfast Gamgee, known as the Gaffer, is Sam's father and was the gardener at Bag End before him.
f5ee2d11: Who forges the Rings of Power with Sauron's deceitful help?
Celebrimbor and the Elves of Eregion
Celebrimbor and the Elven-smiths of Eregion forged the Rings under the guidance of Sauron, disguised as Annatar.
2b34151b: Which work of Tolkien's sets out the full mythology behind The Lord of the Rings?
The Silmarillion is the complete mythology of Middle-earth, edited by Christopher Tolkien after his father's death.
44743e41: What is the name of the harbor from which the Elves leave Middle-earth?
The Grey Havens (Mithlond) are the harbor from which Gandalf, Galadriel, Elrond, Bilbo and Frodo sail into the West.
fd17f60f: Gollum (Sméagol) calls the One Ring “my Precious”. His addiction to the Ring has ravaged his mind.
5d546c36: Legolas Greenleaf comes from Mirkwood, the realm of the Wood-elves ruled by his father Thranduil.
964bfbae: What is the name of the dragon who ravages Erebor in The Hobbit?
Smaug is the winged dragon who seized the Lonely Mountain (Erebor). Bilbo confronts him in The Hobbit alongside his company of Dwarves.
d072c495: What is the name of the Ring of Fire worn by Gandalf?
Narya, the Ring of Fire, is worn by Gandalf and kindles courage against weariness. Círdan gave it to him when he arrived.
8ac67b83: What is the mightiest of the Three Elven Rings, the Ring of Air worn by Elrond?
Vilya, the Ring of Air (with a sapphire), is the mightiest of the Three. Elrond bears it in Rivendell.
f0c229b6: What is the Ring of Water worn by Galadriel?
Nenya, the Ring of Water (or Ring of Adamant), is worn by Galadriel and preserves Lothlórien from the passing of time.
46442d99: What is the Elvish name for the race of Ents, whose eldest is Treebeard?
The Onodrim (Ents) are the shepherds of the trees. Treebeard (Fangorn) is the eldest Ent, called by Gandalf the oldest living thing that still walks in Middle-earth.
e4fe5feb: Who is Círdan the Shipwright in Tolkien's lore?
The lord of the Grey Havens
Círdan is the lord of the Grey Havens, one of the oldest Elves, who kept Narya (the Ring of Fire) until he gave it to Gandalf.
49dcda7c: What name did Sauron take to deceive the Elven-smiths?
Annatar means “Lord of Gifts”: under this guise Sauron deceived the Elven-smiths of Eregion and oversaw the forging of the Rings.
5ea61638: How many members make up the Fellowship of the Ring?
The Fellowship has 9 members: Frodo, Sam, Merry, Pippin, Gandalf, Aragorn, Legolas, Gimli and Boromir, nine like the nine Nazgûl.
24e97fe4: What royal name does Aragorn take at his coronation?
Elessar Telcontar is Aragorn's royal name: Elessar (Elfstone) and Telcontar (Strider), the name of his royal house.
805e3ba8: What are the last two great battles of the War of the Ring?
The battles of the Pelennor Fields and the Black Gate
The battles of Edoras and Minas Tirith
The battles of Moria and Gondor
The Battle of the Pelennor Fields (Minas Tirith), then the Battle of the Black Gate (the Morannon): the final campaign to give Frodo a chance to destroy the Ring.
bebb55f1: Hamfast Gamgee, the Gaffer, is Sam's father. Head gardener at Bag End, he passed on his love of gardening to Sam.
7d959ee4: What is the first name of Frodo's friend who stays behind in the Shire?
Fatty Bolger (Fredegar) stays behind at Crickhollow to keep up the pretense that Frodo is still there while the others take to the road.
425c277e: What was Sauron's original name before he fell under Morgoth's sway?
Mairon (“the Admirable”) was Sauron's name before he joined Morgoth. He was originally a Maia in the service of Aulë the smith.
ba36cca9: What is the name of the great plain before Minas Tirith where the decisive battle takes place?
The Pelennor Fields are the great fertile plain before Minas Tirith, the site of the largest battle of the Third Age.
